_readme: Information checked by hand on Italian universities' OWN websites. 'universities' = rules that apply to all international applicants of that university (keys: university slug). 'programmes' = details for one programme (keys: 'university-slug/programme-slug', see the page address). Use null for anything the official page does not state. Dates YYYY-MM-DD. See CONTENT-GUIDE.md.

padova.englishRequirement: At least B2 level; accepted certificates and minimum scores are listed by the university. Certificates can be submitted after applying, but no later than 31 July 2027.
padova.notes: Applications are made on apply.unipd.it (not used for single-cycle Medicine and Surgery). The first call for 2027/28 has closed — check the website for any later call.

roma-la-sapienza.applicationFee: €30 per application, maximum two applications per academic year; no fee waiver.
roma-la-sapienza.tuition: Sapienza states full tuition of €300–1,500 per year for bachelor’s and master’s programmes, depending on country of residence. Merit and income-based scholarships exist.
roma-la-sapienza.englishRequirement: At least upper-intermediate (B2) English or Italian, depending on the programme.

deadlines.label: 2027/28 pre-selection
deadlines.text: Dates not yet published. For 2026/27, non-EU applicants needing a visa could apply from 22 Dec 2025 to 15 May 2026.

roma-la-sapienza.notes: Pre-selection on Sapienza’s MoveIn platform is mandatory for English-taught programmes, followed by Universitaly pre-enrolment for non-EU applicants.

milano-politecnico.applicationFee: €50 for master’s (Laurea Magistrale) applicants with a foreign qualification — mandatory, non-refundable, cannot be waived.
milano-politecnico.englishRequirement: An English language certificate is part of the application; check the programme’s call for the level required.

deadlines.label: Master’s application periods
deadlines.text: Differ by semester and by nationality (non-EEA, EEA, non-EEA living in Italy) — see the current call.

milano-politecnico.notes: Up to two master’s programmes per semester (1st and 2nd choice). Design and Architecture master’s programmes accept applications for the 1st semester only. Rules shown are for master’s applicants.

bologna.applicationFee: €50 to register for a master’s selection (example: International Management, 2026/27) — paid on Studenti Online.
bologna.tuition: Calculated from the ISEE family-income certificate; applicants without an ISEE have fees calculated from their country of origin and where their family holds income and assets. Exemptions are possible for low ISEE.
bologna.englishRequirement: CEFR B2 for English-taught master’s programmes (example: International Management, 2026/27). The university’s free online English test (OOPT) at B2 or higher is accepted.

deadlines.label: 2027/28 calls
deadlines.text: Not yet published — each programme publishes its own call on its “How to enrol” page. For 2026/27 the OOPT booking deadline for International Management was 13 March 2026.

bologna.notes: Each degree programme at Bologna has its own call, places (some reserved for non-EU citizens living abroad) and deadlines. Rules shown come from the International Management master’s page as an example.

milano.applicationFee: €30 per master’s application (credit card from abroad).
milano.englishRequirement: Set by each programme — see the programme description.

deadlines.label: 2027/28 calls
deadlines.text: Not yet published. For 2026/27 applications opened on 22 January 2026; other deadlines fell between July and October.

milano.notes: Applications through ammissionimagistrali.unimi.it. You can enrol only after the programme’s admission board approves you.

torino-politecnico.applicationFee: €50, non-refundable, paid online by credit card (PagoPA).
torino-politecnico.englishRequirement: English B2 or higher for English-taught programmes (Italian-taught or bilingual programmes also need Italian B2). Accepted certificates are listed in the university’s chart; TOEFL results to code C285. Exemptions for some IB holders and English-taught qualifications from listed countries.

deadlines.label: 2027/28 calls
deadlines.text: Not yet published — in 2026/27 the 1st call opened on 19 December 2025.

torino-politecnico.notes: Rules shown are for master’s applicants with a non-Italian qualification.

palermo.englishRequirement: English-taught programmes: IELTS Academic 5.5, TOEFL iBT 72, PTE 46 or higher; Trinity ISE II–IV, British Institutes and Cambridge English qualifications are also accepted.

deadlines.label: Deadlines
deadlines.text: See the enrolment procedure for non-EU students on the university’s website.

trento.applicationFee: €30 application fee; €100 confirmation fee if admitted.
trento.tuition: For English-taught master’s degrees, tuition depends on the admission score.
trento.englishRequirement: CEFR B2 — an English certificate, a university statement that your degree was taught in English, or a self-declaration if you come from or graduated in an English-speaking country.

deadlines.label: 2027/28 calls
deadlines.text: Not yet published — each master’s programme publishes its own non-EU admission page.

trento.notes: Each programme has its own admission page for non-Europeans; rules shown are from the Computer Science master’s.

pavia.applicationFee: €35 per call, mandatory and non-refundable — pay before the call deadline.
pavia.englishRequirement: Set by each programme — see the programme’s call.

deadlines.label: 2027/28 3rd call closes — EU and non-EU residing in Italy only

pavia.notes: Calendar for programmes without restricted access. Later calls depend on seat availability. Non-EU applicants needing a visa should apply in the first calls.

pisa.tuition: 2026/27: maximum all-inclusive fee €2,900 a year for regular students, reduced according to family income.
pisa.englishRequirement: Set by each English-taught programme — see its call.

deadlines.label: Deadlines
deadlines.text: Each programme’s call sets them; non-EU applicants must also pre-enrol on Universitaly.

pisa.notes: English-taught master’s applications from non-EU citizens living abroad go through applymscenglish.unipi.it.

bolzano.englishRequirement: B2 certification in at least two of the three official languages (Italian, German, English); some master’s programmes are taught only in English.

deadlines.label: Deadlines
deadlines.text: See “Information for non-EU citizens living abroad” on the university’s website.

torino.englishRequirement: Set by each programme — see the programme on apply.unito.it.
torino.notes: From 2027/28 Apply@Unito accepts visa applicants for each programme only up to four times its quota of places, then closes that programme.

milano-bocconi.englishRequirement: Not needed for selection, but a valid English certificate must be provided by the enrolment deadline and by the end of June 2027 at the latest.
milano-bocconi.notes: Rounds shown are for Master of Science programmes. Places in the most popular programmes and most scholarships are more likely to be given in earlier rounds.

genova.applicationFee: €30 for the 2027/28 pre-selection (covers up to two assessment applications).
genova.englishRequirement: Not stated on the admissions page — see the programme page. Italian is not required for English-taught courses.

deadlines.label: 2027/28 visa-applicant pre-selection
deadlines.text: Expected to open in mid-December 2026 and close at the end of March 2027 — exact dates not yet published.

l-aquila.englishRequirement: Set in each call — see the call document.

deadlines.label: Other 2027/28 master’s calls
deadlines.text: Not yet published. For 2026/27 the master’s taught in English deadline was 25 February 2026.

l-aquila.notes: Calls for students with a foreign bachelor’s degree; applications through pica.cineca.it/univaq.

milano-bicocca.englishRequirement: An English certificate from the university’s accepted list (valid five years), due by 5 February 2027 for the 1st call.
milano-bicocca.notes: Choose “NON EU residing abroad” if you need a study visa. Visa applicants must arrive in Italy by 31 January 2028.

siena.englishRequirement: B2 for single-cycle and master’s programmes taught in English (B1 for the Foundation Course), with a certificate from the university’s accepted list or an Italian university language centre. Citizens of the US, UK, Ireland, Australia, New Zealand and Malta are exempt, as are applicants whose entry qualification was taught in English.

deadlines.label: 2027/28 calendar
deadlines.text: Not yet published. In 2026 the non-EU visa deadline for bachelor’s, single-cycle and master’s was 6 May 2026.

siena.notes: Applications outside your category’s period are rejected and fees are not refunded.

perugia.englishRequirement: Set by programme. Engineering Management requires a B2 English certificate from the university’s list (medium-of-instruction letters are rejected).

deadlines.label: 2027/28 deadlines
deadlines.text: Not yet published. In 2026 the general pre-evaluation for visa applicants ran from 29 May to 7 June 2026.

perugia.notes: Apply first through the PICA pre-evaluation portal (one application per candidate), then pre-enrol on Universitaly.

messina.applicationFee: 2027/28: €40, non-refundable — covers up to two applications.
messina.englishRequirement: CEFR B2 for English-taught programmes: IELTS 5.5, TOEFL iBT 72, Cambridge B2 First, PTE General Level 3 (B2) or PTE Academic 59 (certificates valid two years). Exempt: native speakers from listed countries, degrees taught entirely in English there, IB Diploma in English, or programmes using a standardised English test such as IMAT.
messina.notes: Up to two pre-evaluation applications. Incomplete applications are rejected; calls may close early when full.

roma-luiss.notes: Bachelor’s admission for non-EU applicants is either with an international qualification (SAT, LSAT, ACT or IB) or through the online Luiss Test in February 2027.

bari-politecnico.englishRequirement: English B2 is required for 13 English-related master’s degrees (2026/27). Poliba checks it with its own online test (30 questions in 15 minutes, pass mark 21/30), booked through the Microsoft Teams team “2026/27 B2 requirement assessment for master’s degrees” up to three working days before a session. The page does not list external certificates.
bari-politecnico.notes: Architecture has its own B2 requirement. Questions: languages@poliba.it.

roma-tre.englishRequirement: Not stated on the international enrolment page — check the programme’s admission notice.

deadlines.label: 2026/27 Universitaly pre-enrolment — non-EU applicants needing a visa (past cycle)

roma-tre.notes: Non-EU applicants living abroad pre-enrol on Universitaly for a preliminary evaluation; the visa decision is made by the Italian embassy or consulate. The 2027/28 date has not been published yet.

verona.tuition: Students with a study visa or study residence permit may qualify for a flat fee: €500 a year (low and lower-middle income countries, World Bank list) or €1,000 (upper-middle income countries).
verona.englishRequirement: No English test is listed on the page; English-taught master’s applicants are exempt from the Italian test (CISIA ITA-L2). Check the programme’s own requirements.
verona.notes: Pre-enrolment and the visa request go through Universitaly, for one programme at one university. 2027/28 dates are not published yet.

marche.englishRequirement: Seven programmes are taught entirely in English; the page does not state the English level — see the 2026/27 international admissions page.
marche.notes: After a positive pre-acceptance email, non-EU students who need a visa pre-enrol on Universitaly. Univpm offers 120 scholarships of €2,000 for first-time students enrolling in 2026/27.

calabria.tuition: UnicalAdmission scholarship winners have tuition fees covered.
calabria.englishRequirement: Set in the UnicalAdmission call for each master’s programme.
calabria.notes: Unical says the UnicalAdmission call for non-EU master’s applicants for 2027/28 will be published on its page, likely in January 2027. For 2026/27 it awarded 132 scholarships covering tuition, free board and lodging and a €3,600 allowance.

parma.englishRequirement: See Parma’s language requirements page and the programme call on the Admissions Portal.
parma.notes: Calls open to international applicants are published on the Parma Admissions Portal (apply.unipr.it). For 2026/27 the call for English-taught master’s for non-EU visa applicants ran from 15 January to 7 April 2026; the 2027/28 call is not published yet.

bergamo.applicationFee: €30 pre-evaluation fee per master’s course; up to two applications.
bergamo.englishRequirement: An English certificate is one of the five compulsory documents (applications missing any are rejected); the page sets no minimum level — check the course on apply.unibg.it.

deadlines.label: Non-EU pre-evaluation, 1st call (free-access master’s): applications 26 Nov 2026 – 15 Jan 2027
Non-EU pre-evaluation, 2nd call (free-access master’s and limited-access Clinical Psychology): 1–31 Jan 2027

bergamo.notes: Online admission interviews in late February–April 2027; rankings by 31 March (1st call) and 30 April 2027 (2nd call).

camerino.tuition: 2025/26: €556 a year for non-EU students; €456 for citizens of listed developing countries.
camerino.englishRequirement: For English-taught courses, a Cambridge, IELTS or TOEFL certificate may be uploaded but is not mandatory and no minimum is stated; MOI certificates are not accepted. Italian-taught courses need Italian at B2 or higher.

deadlines.label: 2026/27 preliminary evaluation (past cycle; now closed for non-EU)

camerino.notes: Evaluation takes about 3–4 weeks. The 2027/28 pre-admission dates are not published yet.

ferrara.applicationFee: €20 one-time, non-refundable fee, paid by the intake deadline after uploading all documents.
ferrara.englishRequirement: Set per course — see the course description on apply.unife.it.
ferrara.notes: Evaluation takes about 4–6 weeks (bachelor’s and single-cycle) or 6–8 weeks (master’s). Unife asks visa applicants to submit the Universitaly pre-enrolment request as soon as the portal opens.

ca-foscari-venezia.englishRequirement: Depending on the programme, applicants must certify one or more languages; accepted certificates are listed on Ca’ Foscari’s language requirements page (unive.it/pag/16406/).
ca-foscari-venezia.notes: Ca’ Foscari will begin accepting preliminary-evaluation applications for bachelor’s and master’s degrees starting in 2027/28 from December 2026, on apply.unive.it. Non-EU visa applicants also follow the Ministry’s yearly pre-enrolment rules.

milano-cattolica.englishRequirement: See the programme’s entry requirements page on international.unicatt.it.

deadlines.label: 2027/28 BSc Criminology — Round 1 (recommended for non-EU visa applicants), opened 4 Nov 2026

milano-cattolica.notes: Each Cattolica programme has its own application timeline on international.unicatt.it; the dates above are for the BSc in Criminology. Feedback typically comes about 8 weeks after each deadline.

rozzano-mi-humanitas-university.tuition: 2026/27 Medicine and Surgery: admitted candidates pay a first tuition instalment of €5,206 after the ranking is published (non-refundable except in the cases Hunimed lists).
rozzano-mi-humanitas-university.englishRequirement: See Hunimed’s call for applications for non-EU candidates.
rozzano-mi-humanitas-university.notes: Hunimed publishes a separate call for applications for non-EU candidates each year; places depend on Ministry confirmation.

bari.englishRequirement: Not stated on the international admission page — check the course on apply.uniba.it.

deadlines.label: 2026/27 DreamApply pre-evaluation, non-EU visa applicants (past cycle)

bari.notes: Applicants with foreign qualifications first get a pre-evaluation on DreamApply (apply.uniba.it), then non-EU applicants living abroad pre-enrol on Universitaly. For limited-access programmes the Universitaly deadline matches the entrance-test deadline. 2027/28 dates are not published yet.

macerata.applicationFee: €20 application fee, from the 2027/28 academic year, paid when you submit.
macerata.englishRequirement: Proof of language proficiency in the programme’s language of instruction; English-taught programmes need English proof and no Italian.
macerata.notes: One application for one programme only, through official UniMC channels (no intermediaries). In most cases at least 60% of the maximum GPA is required. A recorded online video interview must be completed by the intake deadline. Results are emailed at least two weeks after each intake closes.

brescia.tuition: Holders of international grants funded by UniBS (or with the Italian Government) are exempt from contributions and pay only the first instalment (regional fee and stamp duty).
brescia.englishRequirement: See UniBS’s “Requirements postgraduate degrees” documents for English-taught master’s.
brescia.notes: For 2026/27 UniBS offered 13 LMINT scholarships for non-EU applicants to English-taught master’s and STAR grants for students at risk, applied for via PICA. 2027/28 calls are not published yet.

piemonte-orientale.englishRequirement: Not stated on the enrolment page — check the programme.
piemonte-orientale.notes: For 2026/27 the Universitaly pre-enrolment deadline was mid-September 2026 and late submissions were not accepted. Qualifications are recognised via Qualifyme! or ARDI. Contact international.students@uniupo.it.

urbino.englishRequirement: B2 English certification for the two master’s programmes taught entirely in English (Economics and Management of Cultural Resources and Territories; Modern Languages for Cooperation and International Organizations).
urbino.notes: Master’s applicants apply on apply.uniurb.it, upload all documents by 27 September and interview with a committee; non-EU students living abroad must register by 31 January after getting their visa (2026 entry cycle). Bachelor’s applicants pre-enrol on Universitaly.

salerno.tuition: Non-EU students not resident in Italy are placed in the third contribution band (first band can be requested with documented hardship); citizens of listed low human-development countries are placed in the first band.
salerno.englishRequirement: Not stated. Italian-taught degrees require Italian B2 (or the TEST ITALIANO-L2 online).

deadlines.label: 2026/27 visa procedure must be completed by

salerno.notes: Non-EU applicants living abroad apply through Universitaly; UNISA evaluates each applicant.

trieste.applicationFee: €40, covering applications to up to 3 programmes (2026/27 intake).
trieste.englishRequirement: Not stated on the intake page — check the programme on apply.units.it.
trieste.notes: For 2026/27, rounds ran 15 Dec 2025 – 15 Jan 2026 and 15 Feb – 30 Apr 2026. UniTS says Universitaly pre-enrolment for visa applicants has no university deadline, so apply early. The 2027/28 rounds are not published yet.

salento.applicationFee: €23 admission fee per call for applications, paid via PagoPA.
salento.englishRequirement: Not stated on the admission-notices page — see each call.

deadlines.label: 2026/27 Engineering for Innovation (English-taught, non-EU) application (past cycle)
2026/27 Coastal and Marine Biology and Ecology (past cycle)

salento.notes: Each master’s programme publishes its own call. Non-EU applicants who need a study visa can take admission tests only in the September session, because of the 30 November visa deadline.

udine.englishRequirement: See Uniud’s academic requirements table for English-taught degrees.
udine.notes: English-taught degrees: bachelor’s in Management & Business Analytics; master’s in Economics, International Marketing, Management and Organization, Artificial Intelligence and Cybersecurity, Management Engineering, and Industrial Engineering for Sustainable Manufacturing. Each has an online pre-evaluation; dates are in the yearly notice for non-EU candidates.

firenze.englishRequirement: Not stated on the Admission Document page — check the master’s programme.
firenze.notes: Master’s applicants with foreign qualifications request an Admission Document on the Apply Unifi portal in set intake rounds. Non-EU applicants living abroad who hold one must complete Universitaly pre-enrolment and the visa application by 31 July (by 31 December for single courses). Admission does not guarantee a visa.

napoli-parthenope.tuition: Non-EU students with a study visa/permit: ISEE-based contribution, or a flat €500 (lower-middle-income countries, World Bank list) or €1,000 (other non-EU countries), plus regional tax and stamp duty. Least developed countries: regional tax, stamp duty and the €200 reception fee only. All students pay a €200 reception fee; refugees are fully exempt. Payment only once you are in Italy.
napoli-parthenope.notes: Late-enrolment penalties are waived for non-EU students. Tuition does not cover accommodation or books.

teramo.tuition: See UniTE’s tuition fees page. Visa applicants must show means of €10,179.85 a year.
teramo.englishRequirement: English-taught programmes: B2 (CEFR) certified by the enrolment date — IELTS, TOEFL, Cambridge English or LanguageCert accepted; native speakers exempt; applicants whose degree was taught in English can use an English Proficiency Letter or MOI.

deadlines.label: Universitaly application and visa request (bachelor’s, master’s), from April 2026
Enrolment (open-access programmes), 1 Jul – 5 Nov 2026; late enrolment with fee

teramo.notes: Remote preliminary evaluation has no deadline. Master’s programmes with national limited enrolment follow their own call.

foggia.applicationFee: No separate application fee listed; €160 enrolment fee (A.Di.S.U. fee and stamp duty), due by 30 November (€50 late fee to 31 December).
foggia.tuition: 2026/27, non-EU: €960 a year — €160 enrolment fee plus an €800 all-inclusive fee in three instalments (€300 by 31 Jan, €300 by 31 Mar, €200 by 31 May). An equivalent ISEE can give a full or partial exemption.
foggia.englishRequirement: English-taught courses require B2 English; without proof, the university schedules a proficiency test.

deadlines.label: 2026/27 visa application at the Italian embassy/consulate (after pre-enrolment)

foggia.notes: Non-EU applicants living abroad first submit a university pre-enrolment application and register on Universitaly. Pre-enrolment does not guarantee a visa appointment.

catania.applicationFee: €10 per course (each course needs its own application). €75 non-refundable enrolment confirmation fee within 15 days of admission.
catania.englishRequirement: Set per course in the ‘academic and language requirements’ document; Italian is not required for English-taught master’s.

deadlines.label: 2026/27 public selection, non-EU applicants living abroad — English-taught master’s (past cycle)

catania.notes: The 2026/27 call ran 10 Feb – 17 Mar 2026 for ten English-taught master’s. Unict also announced 50 scholarships for international admissions in 2026/27. The 2027/28 call is not published yet.

cassino.applicationFee: €15 administrative fee for pre-admission (applicants without an Italian qualification), paid on the GOMP portal.
cassino.englishRequirement: A language certificate must be shown at enrolment; the page does not state the level.
cassino.notes: Pre-admission usually runs February–June (each programme sets its exact deadline); Universitaly pre-enrolment usually March–November. Applying early gets an earlier visa appointment.

sannio.tuition: 2026/27, non-EU students living abroad: €500 a year all-inclusive contribution, plus regional tax (€151, or €173 without a valid ISEEU) and €16 stamp duty.
sannio.englishRequirement: English-taught programmes follow each programme’s regulations (e.g. B2 for the master’s in Electronics Engineering for Automation and Sensing).
sannio.notes: Master’s enrolment runs to 31 March 2027 for degrees obtained from 1 January 2027. Universitaly pre-application windows are set yearly by the Ministry; validation does not guarantee a visa.

reggio-calabria.englishRequirement: B2 in every language a course is taught in (e.g. both Italian and English for bilingual courses). Italian B2 can be shown with the CISIA ITA-L2 test.
reggio-calabria.notes: Only one pre-enrolment application for 2026/27. Apply for the study permit at the Reggio Calabria police headquarters within 8 working days of arrival.

roma-saint-camillus.tuition: Set in each course’s Tuition Fees Regulation (first instalment at enrolment).
roma-saint-camillus.englishRequirement: Language certificate at least B2; for English-taught courses, an English certificate covering all four skills.
roma-saint-camillus.notes: Deadlines are set each year in the ministerial procedures and in each admission call. Only one application per academic year.

milano-iulm.applicationFee: An application fee is due before documents are evaluated (amount on IULM’s fees page).
milano-iulm.tuition: First tuition instalment reserves your place; non-refundable except if a non-EU student visa is denied.
milano-iulm.englishRequirement: Italian or English certificate at CEFR B2 covering listening, reading, speaking and writing.
milano-iulm.notes: Non-EU applicants living abroad apply on apply.iulm.it by the end of April (subject to places) and request the visa on Universitaly from March to the end of May.

venezia-iuav.tuition: Study@Iuav 2026/27: 40 tuition-fee waivers for international students on English-taught master’s (Architecture 10, Curating Arts and Heritage 10, Urban and Spatial Planning for Transition 10, Renewable Energy Engineering in Coastal Environment 5, Sustainable Transportation and Smart Maritime Mobility 5). Regional tax and stamp duty still apply.
venezia-iuav.notes: Applicants admitted in the first calls for English-taught master’s are considered automatically for the waiver, renewable on merit for up to three years.

insubria.tuition: Paid by the deadline set for each programme.
insubria.englishRequirement: English-taught courses are exempt from the Italian test; other courses need Italian B2 (or an online oral exam).

deadlines.label: 2026/27 portal applications considered if received by (past cycle)
2026/27 final deadline for entry-qualification documents and study visa

insubria.notes: Universitaly opens each year around late March/early April.

chieti-e-pescara.tuition: Ud’A INT-1 scholarship holders: full exemption from university fees (regional fee €140 and €16 stamp duty still payable).
chieti-e-pescara.englishRequirement: B2 English certification for English-taught programmes.

deadlines.label: 2026/27 Ud’A INT-1 — 15 scholarships for international students (past cycle)

chieti-e-pescara.notes: For 2026/27 Ud’A offered 15 scholarships (€6,000 gross per Article 2 of the call) for one bachelor’s and eight master’s programmes, applications 12 Mar – 20 Apr 2026. The call’s instalment table differs from Article 2, so confirm the amount with the Welcome Office.

milano-san-raffaele.applicationFee: €200 for the International MD Program admission test (both sessions).
milano-san-raffaele.englishRequirement: International MD Program: English at CEFR C1, proven at enrolment.
milano-san-raffaele.notes: For 2026/27 registration ran 17 Dec 2025 – 5 Feb 2026 with home-based tests on 11 Feb and 4 Mar 2026. The 2027/28 call is not published yet.

bra-scienze-gastronomiche.tuition: 2026/27 Undergraduate Degree in Food Sciences and Cultures: €15,500 a year (€2,000 deposit, €7,000 by 1 Sep 2026, €6,500 by 25 Feb 2027).
bra-scienze-gastronomiche.englishRequirement: First-year teaching is in English; see UNISG’s Admission Requirements document.
bra-scienze-gastronomiche.notes: 2026/27 sessions: 20 March, 26 May and 21 July 2026. First-year fee exemptions are offered to students of all nationalities.

napoli-federico-ii.tuition: Compulsory €140 regional fee and €16 stamp duty; EU students pay €200 a year tuition (non-EU amount not stated on the page).
napoli-federico-ii.englishRequirement: English-taught courses do not require Italian B2; an IELTS, TOEFL or Cambridge certificate is useful for the visa application. Check the programme’s call.
napoli-federico-ii.notes: Non-EU students living abroad pre-register on Universitaly; dates are in each course’s call for applications.

castellanza-liuc.tuition: Pre-registration requires a €1,000 first tuition instalment (balance by end of July of the enrolment year); fees are not refunded.
castellanza-liuc.englishRequirement: Language certificates required for the English-taught Business Economics, Business Analytics for Management and Management Engineering programmes (level not stated).
castellanza-liuc.notes: Applicants with a non-Italian secondary qualification should contact the Orientation Office first. Acceptance does not guarantee a visa.
